releases.notes:
## Copy Paster 3.1.0

Fabric client + server mod for Minecraft **26.1.2** (Java 25, Fabric Loader 0.19.2).

Install the **same JAR** on the dedicated server and on each client that uses `[` / `]` copy.

### Highlights

- **Keybind-only copy** — `[` / `]` corners, name in chat (no `/copy`)
- **Paste options** — `at`, `rotate`, `mirror`, `noair`, `confirm`
- **Rotated/mirrored paste ghost** and overwrite undo for transformed footprints
- **LuckPerms** nodes for non-ops; **vanilla operators always allowed**
- **Server limits** — `limits.maxVolume`, `limits.sessionTimeoutSeconds` in `copypaster-server.yml`

### Breaking

- In-game copy requires the **client mod** and bound **`[`** / **`]`** keys
- **`/copy` removed** (interactive and coordinates)

### Fixed (since 3.0.0 tag)

- Operators no longer denied `copypaster.copy` when LuckPerms is installed
- Client corner chat messages use correct translation keys
- `/paste … at …` Brigadier infinite recursion

Full changelog: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/matrunchyk/copypaster/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#310---2026-05-19)

releases.notes:
## Highlights

Major release: the embedded **Web UI** is production-ready with **texture-accurate** 3D structure preview, editing, and save-back to server `.nbt` files.

### Web UI
- **Colors / Textures** viewer modes (Minecraft 1.21.4 assets)
- Special rendering for chests, beds, doors, bells, lanterns, skulls, grass blocks, fences, glass, banners (base color), and more
- **WASD** camera pan, layer slider, palette remap, voxel paint
- Block entity NBT exported for banners and skulls

### Install
- **Server:** `copy_paster-3.0.0.jar` in `mods/` + Fabric API
- **Players:** same JAR on clients for interactive `/copy` and previews
- **Web UI:** enable `web.enabled` in `config/copypaster-server.yml`, then `/copyweb`

After updating, hard-refresh the browser (`Ctrl+Shift+R`).

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/matrunchyk/copypaster/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for full details.

releases.notes:
## Copy Paster v2.1.0

**Minecraft 26.1.2** · **Fabric Loader 0.19.2** · **Fabric API** (required)

Install the **same JAR** on the dedicated server and on each player client (`mods/` folder).

### Added in 2.1.0
- **Ukrainian (`uk_ua`)** — chat, action bar, keybinds, Mod Menu strings
- **Full localization** — `en_us` + `uk_ua`; code uses translatable components

### Since 2.0.0 (included in this build)
- **Interactive `/copy`** — attack two corners; live blue wireframe preview; Use to cancel
- **Paste ghost preview** — cyan overwrite warning before confirm
- **`config/copypaster.yml`** — highlight colour (RGBA)
- **Optional Mod Menu + Cloth Config** for in-game settings
- **Legacy** `/copy x1 y1 z1 x2 y2 z2` and unbound `[` / `]` keybinds still supported

### Install
1. [Fabric Loader 0.19.2](https://fabricmc.net/use/) for Minecraft **26.1.2**
2. [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) in `mods/`
3. `copy_paster-2.1.0.jar` in server **and** client `mods/`

Op-only commands: `/copy`, `/paste`, `/pasteundo`, `/copylist`, `/copyinfo`, `/copydelete`.

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/matrunchyk/copypaster/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for full history.
